subject.title: feat: collapsible queued messages in webchat mobile UI

question: Should queued messages default to collapsed only on phone-width layouts, and should manual expansion remain until the queue empties?
rationale: The space problem is clear, but viewport scope and automatic disclosure-state changes are user-experience policy rather than correctness questions.

options.title: Phone-only collapse
options.body: Default to a compact count on narrow viewports, retain desktop behavior, and reset the disclosure state when the queue empties.

options.title: Collapse on all layouts
options.body: Use the compact default everywhere for consistency, accepting reduced immediate queue visibility on desktop.

options.title: Compact rows without collapse
options.body: Keep all items visible as single-line previews, reducing height without adding disclosure state.

recommendation.title: Phone-only collapse
recommendation.body: Default to a compact count on narrow viewports, retain desktop behavior, and reset the disclosure state when the queue empties.

likelyOwner.reason: Historical WebChat interaction ownership provides the strongest available routing signal for this product choice.
